title: CIS part_of Edges v1 (computer & information sciences skeleton)
description: part_of skeleton edges for the computer-and-information-sciences continent: every /data discipline node of the continent that lacks a part_of parent edge gets one (27 new skeleton nodes from PR #50; subfield:machine-learning already carries its reviewed edge). Construction input only — edges only, zero nodes. Follows the skeleton-part-of-edges-v1 precedent (PR #37-#39) under edge promotion policy v1 (clause 1 live classification grounding), docs/data-foundry.md section 12 (edge-depth freedom: part_of chains may run deeper than two hops) and section 13 (co-equal multiple memberships under the same evidence discipline).

include: part_of edges for the 27 computer-and-information-sciences skeleton nodes promoted in PR #50
Edge-depth decisions per section-12 precedent (e.g. theory-cluster subfields may take subfield:theoretical-computer-science as parent when the classification subsection structure supports it)
Genuine dual memberships proposed as co-equal part_of pairs under section 13 (e.g. information-retrieval's computing and LIS filings), each edge carrying its own classification grounding
ACM CCS 2012 / UDC 004+02 / LCC QA75.5-76.95+Z665-718.8 / MSC 68 classification hints per edge (unverified pointers for QC live grounding)
exclude: All non-part_of relations (prerequisite_for, adjacent_to, applies_to — separate editorial track)
New nodes of any kind (the skeleton node set is closed; gaps are reported, not filled)
Edges duplicating an existing /data (source, target, relation) triple (subfield:machine-learning's part_of edge exists and was migrated in PR #50)
Cross-listing second memberships for formal-sciences nodes (computability-theory, information-theory, game-theory CS-side memberships are session task 3, a separate change)
